# The Epoch Institute

> A historical research site: 394 full profiles of empires and states, a 31,955-entry encyclopedia, a register of
> 5,463 states and their 11,291 connections, country histories, century overviews, an interactive world atlas
> (3500 BCE to today), and the data behind them, free to download.

All reference pages are static HTML with the content in the page itself. Dates use CE/BCE. British English.

## Collections
- [Profiles](https://the-epoch-institute.org/profiles): the 394 in-depth profiles (history, power curve, key facts, references)
- [Encyclopedia](https://the-epoch-institute.org/encyclopedia/): people, events, places, ideas and works; one page per entry at /encyclopedia/<slug>
- [States register](https://the-epoch-institute.org/state/): every recorded state at /state/<id>, with origins, rule and legacy
- [Country histories](https://the-epoch-institute.org/countries/): the states that ruled each present-day country
- [Centuries](https://the-epoch-institute.org/centuries/): one page per century, 30th century BCE to the 21st
- [Today in history](https://the-epoch-institute.org/today-in-history/): a page for each day of the year
- [Glossary](https://the-epoch-institute.org/encyclopedia/glossary): 721 historical terms

## Tools
- [Atlas](https://the-epoch-institute.org/atlas): the world's states in any year
- [Connections](https://the-epoch-institute.org/connections): how states were linked — rule, vassalage, lineage
- [Empire Explorer](https://the-epoch-institute.org/explorer): power trajectories compared

## Data
- [Open Data](https://the-epoch-institute.org/dataset): the states register, relations and power curves as CSV and JSON
- [Sitemap](https://the-epoch-institute.org/sitemap.xml)

## About
- [About the Institute](https://the-epoch-institute.org/about): method and sourcing
- [Contact](https://the-epoch-institute.org/contact)
Please cite pages by their canonical URL; each page shows a suggested citation.
